title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Building Value at the Time of Loss for Coinsurance on a Proof of Loss
content:
Underwriting and claims note for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) on the replacement cost value against which the required insurance is measured when a building amount is sworn on a building proof of loss, where the named insured also holds BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) scheduling the same building.

**Scope.** For a building amount sworn on a building proof of loss, and only for such an amount, the replacement cost value the required insurance is measured against is the building's value at the time of loss settled as the sentences below set out; the required insurance in a building payment or in any other settlement remains measured against the replacement cost value shown on the policy.

**Rule.** The replacement cost value a building proof of loss measures the required insurance against is settled as follows: when the adjuster on the named insured's BizFlood policy whose statement of values schedules the building's address measured, for the same date of loss, that location's replacement cost value at the time of loss, it is the value measured on that adjuster's latest report for the date of loss; when there is no such measurement, that BizFlood policy was in force on the date of loss and its statement of values declares for the building's address a building value above the replacement cost value shown on the policy, it is that declared building value; otherwise it is the replacement cost value shown on the policy.

**Terms.** The building's location on that BizFlood policy is the location number its statement of values gives the building's address. That BizFlood policy is in force on the date of loss when the date of loss falls on or after its effective date, before its term end and before any cancellation effective date it carries. The BizFlood readings above are used only where the named insured's BizFlood statements of values schedule the building's address at most once; otherwise the replacement cost value a building proof of loss measures the required insurance against is the one shown on the policy.

## Records read

From the BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) records: the statement of values entries scheduling the building's address (the location number and declared building value), the BizFlood adjuster's reports for that location and date of loss (the location's value at the time of loss), and that policy's effective date, term end and any cancellation effective date.

## Ladder

| BizFlood records | Value used |
|---|---|
| Address on one BizFlood statement of values; that policy's adjuster measured the location's value at the time of loss for the same date of loss | the value on that adjuster's latest report for the date of loss |
| Address on one statement of values; no such measurement; BizFlood policy in force on the date of loss; declared building value above the value on this policy | the declared building value |
| No such measurement, and the declared building value is at or below the value on this policy, or the BizFlood policy was not in force on the date of loss; or no BizFlood statement of values schedules the address | the replacement cost value shown on the policy |
| Address scheduled on more than one BizFlood statement of values | the replacement cost value shown on the policy |

## In-force cases (hypothetical dates; BizFlood term 1 July to 1 July)

- Date of loss 1 July (its effective date): in force. Date of loss on the term end: not in force. Date of loss on or after a cancellation effective date it carries: not in force.
- An adjuster measurement for the same date of loss is used whether or not the BizFlood policy was in force.
